opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Low‑income households, ordinarily resident in Scotland, not eligible for government tuition fee support, enrolled in an undergraduate degree at a Scottish higher education institution for academic year 2026‑27.
opportunities.summary: Grants cover tuition fees up to £1,820 per year for eligible undergraduate students.

opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Vacation Scholarships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Low‑income households, ordinarily resident in Scotland, penultimate‑year undergraduate students at eligible Scottish institutions.
opportunities.summary: Scholarships provide a stipend to cover living expenses for a 4‑12 week summer research project.

opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Carnegie Masters Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Low‑income households, ordinarily resident in Scotland, enrolled in a taught or research master's programme beginning in 2026/27.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £5,000 per year to support postgraduate study.
